title: CustomHttpHeader - Tooling API
description: Represents a custom HTTP header used with OData 2.0 or OData 4.0 external data sources. Custom HTTP headers provide context information from Salesforce such as region, org details, or the role of the person viewing the external object. This object is available in API version 51.0 and later.

Description.description: A text description of the header field’s purpose.

HeaderFieldName.description: Name of the header field. The name must contain at least one alphanumeric character or underscore. It can also include: ! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ ` | ~

HeaderFieldValue.description: A formula that resolves to the value for the header. The values in the formula must evaluate to a string. If the formula resolves to null and an empty string, the header isn’t sent.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates whether the custom HTTP header is available to use (true) or unavailable (false).

ParentId.description: ID of the entity to which this custom HTTP header is related.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<xsd:complexType name="CustomHttpHeader">
  <xsd:complexContent>
    <xsd:extension base="ens:sObject">
      <xsd:sequence>
        <xsd:element name="CreatedBy" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="CreatedById" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="CreatedDate" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="Description" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="HeaderFieldName" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="HeaderFieldValue" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="IsActive" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="LastModifiedBy" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="LastModifiedById" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="LastModifiedDate" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="Parent" minOccurs="0" type="ens:sObject" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="ParentId" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="SystemModstamp" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime" nillable="true"/>
      </xsd:sequence>
    </xsd:extension>
  </xsd:complexContent>
</xsd:complexType>
```
